why_no_new_batch: The 211 figure counts occurrences with repeated claims, context-only dates/names, partial components, source examples and strict provenance holds; it does not establish 211 unique missing facts.

conclusion: No evidence-supported, ordinary, distinct and currently untested claim remains in the finite residual set that justifies another question batch.
